subject: POC onboarding: stitch plan for API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@aileronhealth.com>, SRE Team <infra@aileronhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC onboarding: stitch plan for API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Alex / Aileron team — thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Per our close cadence, we want to nail down the POC environment setup so your engineers can run a 2-week eval: API keys, org tenancy, IP allowlist, and optional VPC peering.

Quick proposal (requesting owners & dates):
- Redwood provides: sandbox org, one service account with scoped API keys, short-lived tokens guidance, and a sample workload to validate latency/cost. Attachment: poc-credentials-template.xlsx.
- Aileron provides: IP allowlist CIDRs (for hosted mode) or VPC peering contact/acceptance (if you want private connectivity).
- Goal: env ready within 5 business days after we have CIDRs + SRE acceptance; trial window starts once keys validated.

Questions we need answered to schedule work:
1) Which connectivity mode do you prefer? (hosted w/ IP allowlist or VPC peering)
2) If VPC peering: please point to the SRE contact who will accept the peering request and share a preferred maintenance window.
3) For org setup: do you want a single trial tenant or separate per-team tenants?
4) Procurement: who signs the MAP and are there preconfigured CLA/PO terms we should follow?

I'll draft a short MAP with milestones once you confirm owners. Proposed timeline if you confirm today: env prep (2 business days), keys exchange (1 business day), smoke tests (2 business days) — so 5 business days to go-live.

Attachments: poc-credentials-template.xlsx, vpc-peering-guidelines.pdf, mutual-action-plan-draft.docx (MAP draft).

—
Dylan Brooks
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0183

From: Alex Park <alex.park@aileronhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: SRE Team <infra@aileronhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@aileronhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: stitch plan for API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Thanks Dylan — this looks good. Short answers and owners: 
- Connectivity mode: We prefer hosted with IP allowlist initially (lower ops lift).
- CIDRs: infra will supply two /28 blocks we can safely open. Expect these by EOD Monday.
- SRE lead: Jordan Lee (jordan.lee@aileronhealth.com) will own peering if we pivot later.
- Org setup: single trial tenant for the Integrations team is fine.
- Procurement: I'll loop in Procurement for the MAP signature; they need price sheet + standard SOW.

One caveat from infra: we require a list of outbound ports and the FQDNs (for egress allowlist) in addition to source IPs. Can your team provide a minimal egress whitelist?

I'll review the MAP draft Monday and get back with any redlines.

—
Alex Park
Head of Integrations, Aileron Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@aileronhealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: stitch plan for API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Alex — thanks; we'll aim for hosted+IP allowlist first. A few operational clarifications from our side so infra has everything for smoke tests: 
- Outbound egress: default is HTTPS (443) to api.redwood.ai and S3 endpoints for artifact retrieval. Minimal egress FQDNs: api.redwood.ai, auth.redwood.ai, s3.amazonaws.com. We will provide an exact egress list in the MAP doc.
- API keys: we will create one env-scoped API key and a short-lived service token for CI (rotates daily). We recommend your Integrations team use the service token for automated tests. 
- Roles & IAM: the trial tenant will have two roles: "integration_admin" (full infra tests) and "integration_viewer" (read-only). Please confirm who needs admin vs viewer.
- MAP milestones (draft):
   1) Receive CIDRs + egress FQDNs — Aileron (by Mon EOD)
   2) Redwood creates tenant & provisional keys — Redwood (1 business day)
   3) Aileron smoke test & confirm connectivity — Aileron (2 business days)
   4) Joint validation run + sign-off in MAP tracker — both parties (1 business day)

I've updated the attached mutual-action-plan-draft.docx with these steps and added expected acceptance criteria next to each milestone. Kimberly — can you add the sample token rotation policy to the doc?

Thanks — if Aileron confirms CIDRs today we can kick off tomorrow and aim for go-live by next Friday.

To: Alex Park <alex.park@aileronhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@aileronhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: stitch plan for API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround, Alex. To summarize next steps and owners so Procurement has a clean MAP to sign: 
- Aileron (Procurement): confirm PO contact and any standard contract addenda we should expect.
- Aileron (Infra): send CIDRs + egress FQDNs (Jordan / infra).
- Redwood (Marissa / Naomi): provision tenant, create API key + service token, populate MAP milestones in the shared Drive doc.
- Redwood (Kimberly): add token rotation snippet and peering checklist to the MAP doc.

Tentative timeline if we receive CIDRs by Mon EOD: 
- Tue: Redwood provisions tenant + keys; we share credentials (secure link).
- Wed–Thu: Aileron runs smoke tests; open issues triaged via shared Slack channel.
- Fri: joint validation and sign-off — MAP moves to "active".

I've uploaded a revised MAP in Drive and created the HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/RW-3458-AH. Procurement — when you have a PO or DocuSign-ready SOW, route it to procurement@redwood.com and we'll expedite countersign.

Attachments referenced: vpc-peering-guidelines.pdf (for future peering), poc-credentials-template.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-draft.docx.

Thanks all — I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow afternoon 2–2:30pm PT to walk infra through the allowlist and test plan unless I hear otherwise.

—
Dylan Brooks
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
